Ava (Finance): Heads-up: invoice 98732 (ProHealth Labs) ACH failed for $62,400 — bank returned 'account name mismatch'. Need decision: retry, re-collect ACH, or accept wire? Wire needs finance sign-off for >$50k.
Darren (Billing Ops): What's the payment event id?
Ava (Finance): stripe_evt_3K8aWqX. Bank note: 'account_name_mismatch: beneficiary_name does not match account holder'.
billing-bot: Payment failed event recorded for prohealth-labs, last4 ****2345, reason=bank_account_rejected
Darren (Billing Ops): Quick check: customer entered "ProHealth Labs Inc"; bank registry shows "Pro Health Labs" (space). Microdeposits never completed. Recommend wait for customer confirmation before any retry.
Priya (CS): I'm on a call with them now. Treasurer prefers wire and will email PO + bank remittance PDF in ~1-2 hours. Trying to avoid putting them on hold.
Ava (Finance): @Hector please confirm: we can accept wire if they provide PO + signed SOW + remittance PDF and pass AML checks?
Hector (Finance Dir): Conditional approval. Require PO + signed SOW + bank remittance showing beneficiary + standard AML/sanctions screen. Don't release until docs reviewed.
Darren (Billing Ops): Noted. Creating internal hold: ticket #3482, invoice 98732, reason=ACH_name_mismatch, attempts=1, next_action=await_docs. Will not auto-retry.
billing-bot: Manual payout workflow initiated: payout_5591 status=pending_review assigned_to=Darren
Priya (CS): I'll DM the PDF to Ava+Darren when it arrives and update the support ticket with the call notes.
Ava (Finance): Thanks — we'll allow a 48h extension pending docs, then proceed to manual wire if everything checks out. Keep this thread updated. :+1:
